 Serie BKT 2026/27 | #VeronaCesena: Stats and Where to Watch the Match
 Verona - The statistics, figures and facts provided by Opta - Stats Perform ahead of Hellas Verona-Cesena , the 12th matchday of the 2026/27 Serie BKT , scheduled for Friday, November 20 (8.30 PM) at the 'Bentegodi' Stadium .
 HEAD-TO-HEAD 
 Tomorrow's match will be the 27th meeting between Hellas Verona and Cesena in Serie B .
 The last meeting between the two sides at the Bentegodi in this competition dates back to December 30, 2016 , when Hellas Verona claimed a 3-0 victory thanks to goals from Bessa , Pazzini and Boldor . The most recent match against the Romagna-based side at the Bentegodi was played on August 10, 2024 , in the first round of the Coppa Italia .
 FACTS 
 Hellas Verona head into the match having kept three consecutive clean sheets in the league, equalling the number of clean sheets recorded in their previous 27 Serie BKT matches.
 The match will see the team with the most home goals in the league this season, Hellas Verona ( 14 ), face one of the three teams with the fewest away goals. Cesena have scored just four goals on the road, the same number as Carrarese and Benevento .
 PLAYER FOCUS 
 Amin Sarr has provided four assists in the first 11 matchdays of the league season, exceeding his Expected Assists (xA) figure by 2.8 : four assists recorded against an expected value of 1.2 . In Serie BKT , only Fabio Maistro (+3.3) has outperformed the Hellas Verona forward in this statistic.
 12th Matchday, Serie BKT 2026/27 
 HELLAS VERONA-CESENA 
 Friday, November 20, 8.30 PM 
 'Bentegodi' Stadium - Verona 
Live free on DAZN and LaB Channel , available on Amazon Prime and OneFootball
